To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• The API market is growing rapidly and is projected to continue doing so.
• The use of REST APIs in the enterprise is growing quickly and will continue to do so.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of secure APIs.
the problem of how to coordinate access to resources and services in a network of devices and services that may be under the control of different organizations.
the problem of coordinating interactions between applications and the Internet of Things (IoT) using a set of API access control policies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
APIs are here to stay.
the Internet of Things will be driven by APIs.

the Internet of Things is a concept that describes how the Internet is connecting more and more devices to itself, and to us, in a way that allows those devices to share information, data, and resources with one another, and with people.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a system for managing and coordinating interactions with the Internet Of Things (IoT) using OAuth.
we are working towards a system that can be used to control the access to a REST API in an easy way.
we have developed a new API access control model based on OAuth, which we call API-Auth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OAuth is a good fit for API access control.
it is possible to build a secure, usable and scalable API authorization service that can support a large number of clients and resources.
OAuth is not a security panacea.
